Code Examples for Testing

January 16, 2024 by Test Author 1 min read

Code Examples for Testing

This post contains various code examples to test copy button positioning and syntax highlighting.

JavaScript Example

// Array methods
const numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
const doubled = numbers.map(n => n * 2);
const sum = numbers.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n, 0);

console.log('Doubled:', doubled);
console.log('Sum:', sum);

Python Example

def fibonacci(n):
    """Generate Fibonacci sequence up to n terms."""
    fib_sequence = []
    a, b = 0, 1

    for _ in range(n):
        fib_sequence.append(a)
        a, b = b, a + b

    return fib_sequence

# Generate first 10 Fibonacci numbers
result = fibonacci(10)
print(f"Fibonacci sequence: {result}")

TypeScript Example

interface User {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: 'admin' | 'user' | 'guest';
}

class UserService {
  private users: Map<number, User> = new Map();

  addUser(user: User): void {
    this.users.set(user.id, user);
  }

  getUser(id: number): User | undefined {
    return this.users.get(id);
  }

  getAllUsers(): User[] {
    return Array.from(this.users.values());
  }
}

const service = new UserService();
service.addUser({
  id: 1,
  name: "Alice",
  email: "alice@example.com",
  role: "admin"
});

Rust Example

fn main() {
    let numbers = vec![1, 2, 3, 4, 5];

    let sum: i32 = numbers.iter().sum();
    let doubled: Vec<i32> = numbers.iter().map(|&x| x * 2).collect();

    println!("Original: {:?}", numbers);
    println!("Doubled: {:?}", doubled);
    println!("Sum: {}", sum);
}

CSS Example

.button {
  /* Layout */
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  /* Spacing */
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
  gap: 0.5rem;

  /* Appearance */
  background: #0066cc;
  color: white;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0.375rem;

  /* Typography */
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;

  /* Interaction */
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.button:hover {
  background: #0052a3;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
}

Inline Code

You can also use inline code like this: const x = 42; within your text.

The copy button should appear on each code block when you hover over it.
